simple.meaning: to slake the thirst (occasionally of other appetites)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to רָוָה (H7301) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 14 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: רָוָה (râvâh) means to slake the thirst (occasionally of other appetites) First listed occurrence: Isa 16 9.

definitions.short: to slake the thirst (occasionally of other appetites)
definitions.usage: bathe, make drunk, (take the) fill, satiate, (abundantly) satisfy, soak, water (abundantly).

Semitic Lang., Oct. 1902, 48, see also Kö i. 589 f. ; > אֲרַוָּ֫יֶךְ Sta § 634 e Ges § 75dd ); 3 masculine plural suffix יְרַוֻּךָ Prov 5:19 ; Infinitive absolute רַוֵּה Psa 65:11 (Ges § 113z ); — 1 intensive be intoxicated, drunk Isa 34:5 , figurative of sword; + מִדָּם 34:7 , of land (|| יְדֻשָּׁ֑ן ). 2 causative , drench, water abundantly , with accusative תְּלָמֶיהָ (subject ׳י ); Isa 16:9 with accusative of person + דִּמְעָתִי material; saturate (figurative), sate , ׳ור דָּ֑שֶׁן הַכֹּהֲנִים וֶפֶשׁ Jer 31:14 (|| שׂבע ); sexually, יְרַוֻּךָ דַּדָּיהָ Prov 5:19 .
